tools.name: list_pptx_skill_files
tools.title: List Pptx Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'pptx' skill, the platform's guidance for creating, editing, and analyzing PowerPoint (.pptx / .potx) files. Call this any time a deck, slides, or a presentation file is involved - creating pitch decks from scratch with pptxgenjs (including the react-icons + sharp icon pipeline), reading or extracting text from existing presentations, editing or combining slide files, or working with templates, layouts, speaker notes, or comments. The skill bundles helper scripts (add_slide.py, clean.py, thumbnail.py, office/ validators and OOXML schemas) alongside SKILL.md. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md.

project.title: project
project.description: The pptx skill (pptx). Always this value.

tools.name: read_pptx_skill_file
tools.title: Read Pptx Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'pptx' skill in full, for creating, editing, or analyzing PowerPoint (.pptx / .potx) files. Pass filePath exactly as list_pptx_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide covering deck creation with pptxgenjs, the react-icons + sharp icon rasterization pipeline, template editing, text extraction, and the bundled validation and thumbnail scripts under scripts/.

project.title: project
project.description: The pptx skill (pptx). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_pptx_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
